items.name: CubingUSA Great Lakes Championship 2026

venue.name: [Grand Wayne Convention Center](https://www.grandwayne.com/)
venue.address: 120 W Jefferson Blvd, Fort Wayne, IN 46802

items.information:
![GLC 2026 Logo](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTM5NDM1LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--9a86a490f68115ce466f841046c49054e0f69caa/GLC26Logo.png)
![Partnered organizations' logos](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTM5NzM2LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--7b0f0ed544f3ae9a0ca829fe38f97bd9d2f0cc6c/ghYzBXw.png)

This competition is supported by the *[Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.midwestcubing.org/)* and *[CubingUSA](https://www.cubingusa.org/)* as the Great Lakes Regional Championship of 2026.

Competitors from Illinois, Indiana, Kentucky, Michigan, Ohio, and Wisconsin are eligible for the title of Great Lakes Champion.

items.name: Headache in Kode 2026
items.information:
Välkomna till Headache in Kode 2026!

Notera att detta är en tävling som fokuserar på ögonbindel-grenarna, och inte har de vanligaste grenarna såsom 3x3 och 2x2. 

Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information.

-----

Welcome to Headache in Kode 2026!

Please note that this competition focuses on the blindfolded events, and does not have the most popular events, such as 3x3 and 2x2.

We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information.

[![](https://cuboss.se/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/cuboss-svekub-loggor.png)](https://svekub.se/om_oss/svekub-cuboss/)

items.name: Middletown Mixup 2026
items.information: This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, please refer to the Competition Procedures tab.

items.name: Pulmapelipäivät 2026
items.information:
Please read through the [regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition.
The schedule may be subject to change, so if you're leaving the venue during the day, make sure to return at least 30 minutes before your scheduled events.

Lue säännöt ([englanniksi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/), [suomeksi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/finnish/)) ennen kilpailua.
Aikataulu voi muuttua, joten jos poistut kisapaikalta päivän aikana, palaa vähintään 30 minuuttia ennen lajejasi.
